title: ScapeGoat
subtitle: 1968 Pontiac A-Body Outlaw Drag Car
summary: Weathered patina exterior with Alpine Blue roll cage, built 6.2L L94 V8, Tremec T-56 Magnum 6-speed, 35-spline Ford 9-inch, and 31x18 Mickey Thompson rears.
narrative: ScapeGoat is a 1968 Pontiac A-body outlaw drag build designed to preserve its weathered patina exterior while housing a serious chassis and powertrain.
Features an Alpine Blue full roll cage, a built 6.2L L94 V8 mated to a Tremec T-56 Magnum 6-speed manual transmission, a 4-inch aluminum driveshaft, and a 35-spline Ford 9-inch rear axle.

Out back, 15x15 Weld ProStar wheels carry 31x18 Mickey Thompson Sportsman tires, suspended by UMI and BMR linkages with Viking coilovers. Provenance traces back to the assembly line as 'Body Brothers' with its companion GTO build.

title: BillyGoat
subtitle: 1968 Pontiac GTO Pro-Touring Restomod
summary: Companion 'Body Brother' build featuring factory sheet metal, a 400ci Pontiac engine, double adjustable control arms, and an autocross-tuned setup.

specifications.suspension: Double Adjustable Upper Arms / Autocross Stance

narrative: BillyGoat is a 1968 Pontiac GTO Pro-Touring restomod built as the companion 'Body Brother' to ScapeGoat.

Retaining factory sheet metal with firewall stampings TA20 and ZA23, it features a 400ci Pontiac V8 engine, double adjustable upper control arms, and a suspension setup tuned specifically for autocross and road touring agility.

title: Torky-T
subtitle: 1923 Ford T-Bucket Roadster
summary: Vintage white fiberglass body, built 350 SBC V8, Quick Fuel SS-750 4-barrel, Vertex magneto ignition, and 29x18.5LT15 Mickey Thompsons.
narrative: Torky-T is a classic 1923 Ford T-Bucket roadster sporting a vintage white fiberglass body and traditional white vinyl pleated upholstery.

Powered by a built 350 small-block Chevy topped with a Quick Fuel SS-750 carburetor and a Vertex magneto ignition system serviced by Don Zig Magnetos. Backed by a TH350 transmission feeding a Ford 9-inch rear end wrapped in massive 29x18.5LT15 Mickey Thompson rubber.

title: Not for Higher
subtitle: 1952 GMC COE Crew Cab Flatbed Tow Truck
summary: 1952 GMC Cab-Over-Engine body mounted on a RAM 5500 chassis, 6.7L Cummins, compound turbos, single 10mm stroker CP3, and air-ride cab subframe.
narrative: Project 'Not for Higher'—an intentional play on words—combines a 1952 GMC Cab-Over-Engine Crew Cab shell mounted over a heavy-duty RAM 5500 chassis.

Powered by a 6.7L Cummins diesel with compound turbochargers, fed by a single 10mm stroker CP3 injection pump and a 165 GPH FASS lift pump. Comfort and modern feedback are managed via an air-ride cab subframe and Edge Insight CTS3 display.
